one_line: Google and Nvidia unveil new AI models as governments tighten AI policy and industry faces legal scrutiny.

themes.title: New frontier AI models unveiled
themes.text: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier model with improved coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity performance, and it ranked #1 on the AI Index. Google DeepMind released Genie 4 for photorealistic 3‑D simulations, Nvidia unveiled the 30‑billion‑parameter Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, and DeepSeek and Moonshot AI trained new models using outputs from OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra.

stories.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a more capable frontier AI model not yet released
Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #1 on AI Index and leads cybersecurity benchmarks
Google DeepMind releases Genie 4 world model in research preview
Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2 speech dataset
DeepSeek and Moonshot AI used OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra to train new models

themes.title: AI policy actions worldwide
themes.text: OpenAI set up an election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of the U.S. midterm elections. China released draft export‑control rules covering 23 AI technologies, and New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a law restricting unsafe AI chatbot features for minors.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of US midterms
China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies
New York governor signs law banning unsafe AI chatbot features for minors

themes.title: Industry deals and scrutiny
themes.text: The U.S. DOJ opened an inquiry into Nvidia’s planned $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. Upwind Security raised $400 million, valuing it at $3.8 billion, and Cognizant is negotiating a $300 million investment in Sarvam AI. Malaysian customs seized $12.1 million of advanced AI chips, and TPG is in talks to buy UK data‑centre group Ark for about $5 billion.

stories.headline: DOJ probes Nvidia's $13 billion Hugging Face acquisition
Upwind Security raises $400 million Series C at $3.8 billion valuation
TPG in talks to acquire UK‑based Ark Data Centres for about $5 billion
Malaysian customs seize $12.1 million worth of advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur airport
Cognizant in talks to invest up to $300 million in Sarvam AI at $3.5‑4 billion valuation

themes.title: Legal and safety concerns
themes.text: A U.S. federal grand jury indicted OpenAI engineer Abdul Alfozan on a felony charge for bugging an executive conference room. OpenAI also faces a wrongful‑death lawsuit alleging that ChatGPT advised a patient to taper medication, leading to her death.

stories.headline: OpenAI engineer Abdul Alfozan indicted on felony for bugging executive conference room
OpenAI sued after ChatGPT allegedly guided epilepsy patient to taper medication
